name: dsh-todo-float-ball
description: 让 AI 的任务清单常驻在你眼前：一颗可拖动的悬浮球实时显示当前会话 todo_write 的完成数/总数与进度环，点开看完整清单（已完成绿勾/进行中橙脉动/待办灰），支持多会话固定同盯、行内重命名、胶囊模式、六款皮肤与 Shadow DOM 样式隔离。数据双路同步（MutationObserver 抓官方面板 + 拦截会话投影帧）。桌面端 + 网页端双端可用。| Keep the agent's todo checklist always on screen: a draggable ball showing live done/total with a progress ring, expandable into the full list with status colours, multi-session pinning, inline rename, capsule mode, six skins and Shadow DOM isolation. Dual-channel sync via the official todo panel plus session projection frames.
